preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 and 1 <= m <= 2 * 10**5 for n, m in zip(test_cases_n, test_cases_m))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of rows and columns is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_ij <= 10**9 for a_ij in all_elements)
preconditions.description: Each element in the grid is a positive integer between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: After swapping the specified columns, the grid is good.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value == -1 or (len(return_value) == 2 and 1 <= return_value[0] <= m and 1 <= return_value[1] <= m) for return_value, m in zip(return_values, test_cases_m))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a pair of column indices between 1 and m.
